cases.title: Infill rental packet
cases.focus: Prioritize financing sensitivity if the evidence supports analyst review.

cases.title: Small multifamily packet
cases.focus: What needs to be collected before an analyst can review this packet?

verify-comps.label: Validate comp selection
verify-comps.detail: Verify transaction dates and arm’s-length status against the source records.

stress-debt.label: Stress-test financing terms
stress-debt.detail: Run the downside case with a higher borrowing cost and review covenant headroom.

verify-supply.label: Confirm delivery timing
verify-supply.detail: Check the assumed opening dates with the listed projects before underwriting rents.

collect-comps.label: Obtain recent closed-sale comps
collect-comps.detail: Request at least five closed sales dated within the 90-day lookback.

refresh-debt.label: Refresh the lender indication
refresh-debt.detail: Request dated indicative terms and confirm the rate, leverage and conditions.

collect-supply.label: Update the supply pipeline
collect-supply.detail: Request a dated pipeline scan for the subject trade area.

documents.title: Diligence standard §1 · Comparables
documents.text: The analyst packet requires at least five closed-sale comparables in a snapshot dated within 90 calendar days of intake.

documents.title: Diligence standard §2 · Financing
documents.text: The analyst packet requires a dated lender indication within 30 calendar days of intake. Indicative terms are subject to underwriting.

documents.title: Diligence standard §3 · Supply
documents.text: The analyst packet requires a dated supply-pipeline scan within 90 calendar days of intake.

documents.title: Diligence standard §4 · Routing
documents.text: Hold the packet while any required check is missing, stale or below threshold. Route a complete packet to a human analyst. An analyst handoff carries no acquisition authorization.

documents.title: Closed-sales snapshot
documents.text: The mock broker export shows seven closed sales for the subject trade area. The comparison set still requires analyst verification.

documents.title: Indicative lender terms
documents.text: The mock lender email gives indicative terms and identifies borrowing cost and covenant headroom for downside analysis.

documents.title: Supply-pipeline scan
documents.text: The mock market scan identifies two planned deliveries near the subject trade area and gives expected delivery windows.

documents.title: Intake record · Comparable sales
documents.text: The intake log records the request for recent sales. A closed-sales snapshot has yet to arrive.

documents.title: Indicative lender terms
documents.text: The mock packet contains an indicative lender email dated October 1. The intake log lists no newer lender indication.

documents.title: Supply-pipeline scan
documents.text: The mock market scan lists planned deliveries and their expected timing within the subject trade area.
